description.zh-CN: 岛上的「天气」页显示所选城市的当前天气、今天逐小时和未来 7 天；可选在收起条上显示天气和温度，以及一小时内要下雨时在岛上提醒。在插件设置里填城市名，不读系统定位；不填城市时不联网。数据来自 Open-Meteo，不需要账号。用 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 运行。
description.en: A Weather page on the island with the current weather, today's hours and the next 7 days for the city you pick; optionally the weather and temperature on the collapsed bar, and a heads-up when rain is due within the hour. Type the city in the plugin settings; your location is never read, and nothing goes online until a city is set. Data from Open-Meteo, no account needed. Runs on the PowerShell built into Windows.

description.zh-CN: 填城市名，例如「杭州」或「Springfield, Illinois」；同名城市可以在逗号后加省、州或国家区分。留空时插件不联网。
description.en: A city name such as "London" or "Springfield, Illinois"; add the state, province or country after a comma to tell same-named places apart. Leave it empty and the plugin stays offline.

title.zh-CN: 收起条显示天气和温度
title.en: Show the weather on the collapsed bar

description.zh-CN: 打开后插件一直运行，按刷新间隔更新。
description.en: Keeps the plugin running and updates it at the refresh interval.

title.zh-CN: 一小时内要下雨时提醒
title.en: Tell me when rain is due within the hour

description.zh-CN: 每 30 分钟查一次，同一场雨只提醒一次。
description.en: Checked every 30 minutes; one heads-up per shower.
